description: MainActivity class implementing a feedback form with persistence via SharedPreferences, includes data classes and utility objects for JSON encoding/decoding, and a custom adapter for displaying feedback entries. The file manages UI interactions, data storage, and rendering logic for a feedback collection Android app.

classes.name: FeedbackItem
classes.description: Data class representing a feedback entry with id, name, and feedback text.

classes.name: FeedbackStorageCodec
classes.description: Utility object providing encode and decode functions for serializing and deserializing feedback entries to and from JSON strings.

classes.name: FeedbackAdapter
classes.description: Custom list adapter for displaying FeedbackItem entries with minimal styling and a 'NEW' badge for the latest item.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, binds views, sets up listeners, loads existing feedback, and prepares the UI.

methods.name: isFormValid
methods.description: Checks whether the name and feedback input fields are non-empty to enable submit button.

methods.name: onSubmit
methods.description: Handles form submission: creates FeedbackItem, persists it, updates UI, and clears inputs.

methods.name: showToast
methods.description: Displays short toast messages for user feedback.

methods.name: loadFeedback
methods.description: Loads feedback list from SharedPreferences, parsing JSON string into list of FeedbackItems.

methods.name: saveFeedback
methods.description: Serializes and saves feedback list into SharedPreferences.

methods.name: encode
methods.description: Encodes a list of FeedbackItem objects into a JSON string.

methods.name: decode
methods.description: Decodes a JSON string into a mutable list of FeedbackItems.

methods.name: parseObject
methods.description: Parses a JSON object string into a FeedbackItem instance.

methods.name: extractNumber
methods.description: Helper to extract numeric id from JSON object string.

methods.name: extractString
methods.description: Helper to extract string fields from JSON object string, handling escapes.

methods.name: escape
methods.description: Escapes special characters in strings for JSON encoding.

methods.name: setItems
methods.description: Updates the adapter's data set and refreshes the list view.

methods.name: getCount
methods.description: Returns total number of feedback items.

methods.name: getItem
methods.description: Returns a feedback item at a specific position.

methods.name: getItemId
methods.description: Returns the unique id of feedback item at position.

methods.name: getView
methods.description: Creates or reuses a view for a feedback item, sets data, and badge visibility.
